thread:
Maya (Sales): @here Acme legal sent back the security questionnaire. They want a PO C next Tues. Requirements: hosted demo API keys (short-lived), option to run on a Dedicated pool later, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk HEC + encrypted S3, and confirmation on who can see logs. Deadline: EOD Fri.
Carlos (Solutions): Thanks — basic plan: we can provision ephemeral API keys for the demo (30d TTL) and enable audit export to S3 + Splunk HEC. Dedicated pool pricing: rough estimate below, will confirm with infra. Do they need full request/response logging or just request metadata? That changes privacy/retention answers.
Maya (Sales): Customer says they need full request/response for compliance but want controls to mask PII. Also asks about IP allowlist for API keys and VPC/private deployment timeline if we move to Dedicated.
Priya (Infra): Notes: we can support both flow types.
- Hosted demo: enable audit export to a customer-owned S3 bucket (we write objects with kms-encrypted keys) and optionally push events to their Splunk HEC.
- Private/Dedicated: logs are stored in the customer VPC and can be shipped same way.
Priya (Infra): S3 export sample config (for docs):
```
export_target: s3
s3_bucket: acme-poc-logs
s3_prefix: redwood/audit
kms_key_alias: alias/redwood-poc-acme
object_encryption: AES256
retention_days: 90
```
Priya (Infra): For Splunk HEC we need their HEC token + endpoint. We support HEC input with TLS and basic cert validation. IP allowlist: we can add API key-level allowlist (CIDR) for hosted keys; for Dedicated we can restrict to VPC egress only.
Anita (Security): From the questionnaire POV:
- Access: logs are accessible to customer (via S3) and to Redwood SRE on a need basis; access is audited internally. We will provide a link to our SOC2 controls and an S3 ACL breakdown.
- Retention: default POC retention = 90 days. We can extend to 365 with signed agreement.
- KMS: we use customer-managed KMS for S3 exports when requested; otherwise Redwood-managed keys with CMKs.
- Sensitive data: we can enable redaction pipeline to mask PII before export. This is opt-in and must be toggled before POC.
Anita (Security): Quick phrasing for questionnaire answers you can paste:
"Audit logs (request metadata and optionally full request/response) can be exported to a customer-owned S3 bucket or pushed to a customer Splunk HEC. All exports are encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES-256). Customer-managed KMS keys are supported. Access to logs is limited to authorized Redwood personnel and is itself logged. Default retention for POC exports is 90 days; retention can be extended per contract."
Tom (Account): Pricing note — Dedicated pool ballpark for this workload: ~$12k/month (3x A10-like GPUs) for the initial POC window; can do a week-long burst with reserved credits instead of full month. I'll confirm exact quote. Also need to confirm who signs the data processing addendum for extended retention.
Maya (Sales): Action items: 1) Provide Acme with ephemeral demo keys + IP allowlist option. 2) Share Anita's questionnaire text. 3) Get HEC token and S3 bucket + KMS alias from Acme. 4) Carlos/Priya to toggle redaction if requested.
Carlos (Solutions): I'll draft a short runbook for the POC: key issuance steps, how to enable S3/HEC export, and the redaction toggle. ETA: Wed EOD.
Priya (Infra): deploy-bot kicking off resources for hosted demo now.
deploy-bot: Provisioning request accepted: demo-keys (30d TTL) and audit-export pipeline precheck queued. ETA health-check: ~15m. JobID: pb-1791012345-01 :white_check_mark:
Maya (Sales): Thanks — I'll ping Acme for HEC + bucket details and circulate Anita's wording. If we need a Dedicated trial instead, I will escalate.
Anita (Security): If they want full request/response in logs, add note: we recommend redaction for PII and require explicit sign-off from customer security. Also, note that storing full responses may require extra legal review.
Carlos (Solutions): Noted. I'll include the redaction instructions in the runbook and a sample Splunk HEC mapping. Will post the runbook link here when ready.
Maya (Sales): Perfect. End-to-end owner: Carlos. I'll loop Tom for billing confirmation once we have HEC/bucket details.
